7b1b76a38eb772f2.description: نبذة عن الدور تعلن الشركه السعوديه للكهرباء والتبريد للاستثمار عن حاجتها لتوظيف فني كهربائي شبكات توزيع أرضية للعمل بدوام كامل في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على دراسة المخططات التنفيذية لشبكات التوزيع الأرضية، وتقدير المواد اللازمة، ومتابعة تنفيذ أعمال التمديد والتوصيل، بالإضافة إلى تحديد مواقع الأعطال وإصلاحها. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة المخططات التنفيذية الخاصة بتمديد وتوصيل شبكات التوزيع الأرضية والكابلات. تقدير كميات المواد والأجهزة المطلوبة، ومطابقة مواصفاتها، ومتابعة تأمين الأدوات والمعدات اللازمة لتنفيذ الأعمال. متابعة تنفيذ برامج أعمال تمديد وتوصيل الكابلات، وتوزيع المهام على فرق العمل، والتنسيق مع الجهات الهندسية الأخرى. الكشف على مسار الكابلات، ومتابعة أعمال الحفر والتمديد والطمر، بالإضافة إلى متابعة إجراء وصلات الكابلات ووصل نهاياتها مع عناصر منظومة التوزيع المختلفة. متابعة تحديد مواقع الأعطال والوصلات، وتأريض واستعزال الكابلات، وتشخيص أعطالها، ومتابعة إجراءات إصلاحها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على قراءة وفهم المخططات التنفيذية لشبكات التوزيع الكهربائية. معرفة بأساسيات تمديد وتوصيل الكابلات الأرضية. بيئة العمل يعمل الفني الكهربائي ضمن فريق عمل في مدينة مكة المكرمة، ويشمل الدور مهام ميدانية تتطلب الكشف على مسارات الكابلات ومتابعة أعمال الحفر والصيانة. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. المنطقة: مكة المكرمة. الراتب: لم يتم الإفصاح عنه. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الوظيفة.

7b2a7cb349cbfe1b.description: About UCC Holding UCC Holding is seeking a Procurement Engineer to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position for a professional with 5-10 years of experience in procurement, specifically overseeing the purchase of technical equipment for industrial operations. Role Overview The Procurement Engineer is responsible for managing the acquisition of technical equipment required for industrial operations. This involves close collaboration with designers to identify necessary equipment for manufacturing or construction projects based on specifications, researching suitable vendors, and placing orders. The role focuses on optimizing procurement processes to achieve strategic business objectives and cost efficiencies. Key Responsibilities Contribute to the development of procurement management strategies and practices to maximize value. Ensure understanding of strategic business relationships to support business plans and strategies. Provide market insights to stakeholders and business units. Collaborate in formulating strategic plans that capture total procurement value for competitive advantage. Contribute to the creation and implementation of best practice procurement vision, strategy, policies, processes, and procedures. Engage with internal and external stakeholders to develop strong relationships, aiming for improved service and reduced supply costs. Support senior functional leaders in establishing short and long-term business objectives. Utilize industry knowledge and advanced business models to develop strategies for business relationships. Ensure clear understanding of measurable goals for continuous improvement, using financial and quantitative data for performance management. Assist in implementing best practice purchasing policies, processes, and procedures to improve business performance and achieve financial targets. Maintain and update information on suppliers, materials, and services that meet business requirements. Adhere to the department's long-term cost reduction and value improvement plans for specific spend areas. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Civil or Architectural Engineering. Minimum of 8 years of working experience, with at least 5 years in a relevant procurement role. 2 years of GCC experience is preferred. Application Process Candidates who meet the above qualifications are encouraged to apply for this full-time position in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

7b2e8c371f32617b.job_title: Senior Specialist Statutory Financial Reporting & Controls
7b2e8c371f32617b.description: About the Role J-B is seeking a Financial Accounting and Regulatory Reporting Senior Officer to join its Finance team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position requires 2-5 years of experience and focuses on supporting financial accounting and regulatory reporting activities. The role ensures accurate and timely financial reporting in compliance with applicable accounting standards and regulatory requirements, with a particular emphasis on Zakat and Tax, especially VAT. Key Responsibilities Prepare financial statements and regulatory reports in accordance with IFRS, SAMA regulations, and applicable accounting standards. Prepare, review, and submit regulatory reports to SAMA and other relevant regulatory authorities within established deadlines. Ensure the accuracy and consistency of financial data across internal and external reports. Coordinate with relevant departments to collect, validate, and reconcile financial information. Support Zakat and Tax-related reporting activities, particularly VAT. Monitor changes in financial reporting standards and regulatory requirements. Coordinate with external auditors and internal stakeholders on financial reporting matters. Support the improvement of financial reporting processes, systems, and controls. Maintain accurate financial records and supporting documentation. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of practical financial reporting experience. Background in Zakat and Tax, with specific experience in VAT. Demonstrated ability to ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards and regulatory requirements. 7b61565494c175fe.description: About the Role of Hotel Cleanliness Expert Sheraton Hotels & Resorts is seeking a Hotel Cleanliness Expert to join its team in Dammam, Eastern region. This full-time role focuses on maintaining the hotel's appearance and cleanliness to ensure a positive guest experience. The position is suitable for candidates with 0-1 years of experience. Role Overview The Hotel Cleanliness Expert is responsible for a range of housekeeping tasks that contribute to the overall guest environment. This role involves ensuring that all hotel spaces meet cleanliness standards and support an exceptional guest experience, extending beyond basic room cleaning to the entire property. Key Responsibilities Responding to guest requests promptly and efficiently. Stocking and maintaining housekeeping carts. Cleaning guest rooms and public areas according to established standards. Performing other similar housekeeping duties as required. General Workplace Expectations Contributing to a safe workplace environment. Adhering to all company policies and procedures. Maintaining confidentiality of guest and company information. Upholding quality standards in all tasks. Ensuring professional appearance, uniform, and communication. With over 400 establishments worldwide, Sheraton focuses on creating a sense of belonging for guests through enriching experiences and attentive service. 7bca4c92af4152a1.description: About the Role AECOM is seeking a Senior Document Control professional to join our team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves overseeing all aspects of document management, control, and compliance within the organization. The successful candidate will lead a team responsible for maintaining the integrity, security, and accessibility of critical business documents, ensuring adherence to regulatory standards and organizational policies. Key Responsibilities Develop, implement, and maintain comprehensive document control procedures and policies aligned with organizational standards and regulatory requirements. Oversee the classification, indexing, storage, and retrieval of all organizational documents to ensure accuracy and accessibility. Lead and supervise the document control team, providing guidance, training, and performance feedback. Manage document management systems (DMS), ensuring proper configuration, maintenance, and optimization. Conduct regular audits and quality assurance reviews to verify compliance with document control standards. Establish and enforce version control protocols to prevent the use of outdated or unauthorized documents. Coordinate with various departments to ensure timely document submission, approval, and distribution. Develop and deliver training programs to staff on document control procedures, system usage, and compliance requirements. Monitor and report on key performance metrics related to document control operations. Ensure compliance with applicable regulations, industry standards, and organizational policies regarding document retention and disposal. Collaborate with management to identify process improvement opportunities and implement solutions. Maintain detailed records of all document transactions and generate reports for management review and audit purposes. Qualifications and Experience Minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in document control, records management, or related administrative functions. Proven experience leading and managing document control teams. Advanced proficiency with document management systems (DMS) and related software applications. Strong knowledge of document control methodologies, best practices, and industry standards (*, ISO 9001, ISO 27001). Comprehensive understanding of regulatory compliance requirements and audit procedures. Demonstrated expertise in version control, change management, and configuration management. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and database management. Experience with quality assurance and continuous improvement initiatives. Knowledge of the Saudi Arabia regulatory environment and business practices is preferred. Experience in regulated industries such as oil and gas, construction, manufacturing, or engineering is preferred. Required Skills Exceptional organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with a focus on process optimization. Demonstrated ability to train, mentor, and develop team members. Meticulous attention to detail with a commitment to accuracy and precision. Work Environment This role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and operates on a full-time schedule. The position requires a professional who can implement efficient document control processes across the organization and lead a dedicated team.

7be6e8719637fc66.description: About AECOM AECOM is a global infrastructure consulting firm dedicated to delivering a better world by improving commutes, providing access to clean water, and transforming skylines. With a global team of over 50,000 professionals, AECOM partners with clients to solve complex challenges and build legacies for future generations. The company is committed to projects with a positive and tangible impact worldwide. The Role of Contracts Manager AECOM is seeking a Contracts Manager to join its team in Makkah, with operations spanning Jeddah and Makkah. This is a contract position focused on managing and administering construction contracts for high-rise and complex projects. The role ensures compliance with contractual terms, conditions, and regulatory requirements, operating and managing project management information systems for contract data, milestone tracking, and change order management. Key Responsibilities Manage and administer construction contracts for high-rise and complex projects, ensuring compliance with contractual terms, conditions, and regulatory requirements. Operate and manage project management information systems, performing tasks such as storing contract data, tracking milestones, managing change orders, and generating compliance reports. Review contract documentation, technical specifications, and project schedules from project teams regarding deliverables, timelines, budget allocations, and performance metrics. Research contractual obligations, identify potential risks and disputes, and analyze contract terms to ensure alignment with project scope and organizational standards. Record contract amendments, verify accuracy of contractual data, and prepare contract summaries, risk assessments, and performance reports for stakeholder review. Work on problems of diverse scope across multiple concurrent projects and stakeholder groups, typically receiving general instructions on new project assignments. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in contract management. Full understanding of construction contract management and high-rise project delivery. Proven ability to manage and administer contracts under limited supervision. Work Environment and Commitment AECOM fosters a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration, and community, offering opportunities for growth and career ambition. The company is committed to maintaining a secure recruitment process, requiring all newly hired employees to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment. Application Information AECOM is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All information provided will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Salary for this position will be disclosed during the interview process.

7b12ed1fe923ed79.description: About the Role Alfanar is seeking a Sales Representative Real Estate Development to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position focuses on driving property sales by generating leads, engaging with potential buyers, presenting properties, and closing sales. The role serves as the primary contact for prospective clients and contributes directly to achieving the company's sales targets while ensuring customer satisfaction. Key Responsibilities Identify prospective customers and generate leads through direct contact, referrals, networking, and industry events. Assess customer requirements to identify suitable sales opportunities. Gather market and competitor information to support sales activities and communicate relevant customer feedback. Present properties, explaining their features, benefits, and suitability for customer needs. Respond to customer inquiries and coordinate technical or product clarifications with relevant teams. Negotiate prices and commercial terms within approved guidelines and delegated authority. Follow up on offers and secure orders to achieve assigned sales targets and KPIs. Maintain regular contact with customers to strengthen relationships and encourage repeat business. Identify cross-selling and upselling opportunities based on customer requirements. Coordinate the resolution of complaints and after-sales issues, following up to confirm customer satisfaction. Process sales orders and verify customer requirements and agreed commercial terms. Coordinate with relevant teams to support timely order fulfillment and delivery. Keep customers informed of order progress and follow up on delays or discrepancies. Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, sales opportunities, and pipeline progress. Prepare sales reports and forecasts, highlighting performance against targets and outstanding opportunities. Collaborate with marketing, customer support, and product teams to coordinate customer engagement and service delivery. General Responsibilities Continuously update soft and technical skills relevant to the job. Develop and execute a personal career path plan. Perform planned activities to meet operational and development targets as per delivery schedules. Utilize resources effectively to achieve objectives within efficient cost and time. Provide periodic reports detailing deviations and execution of planned tasks. Solve related problems and escalate complex operational issues as needed. Ensure quality requirements are met, including developing effective quality control and processes. Coordinate well-defined written systems, policies, and procedures, seeking automation opportunities. Comply with all related policies, procedures, and work instructions. Ensure compliance with relevant safety, quality, and environmental management procedures and controls. The role requires active engagement with customers and collaboration with internal teams to achieve sales objectives.

7b409d95a76ef2f1.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مصنع أقوات للصناعات الغذائية عن مهندس ميكانيكي للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات للمشاريع الميكانيكية، بالإضافة إلى تطوير برامج التجميع والتركيب والتشغيل والصيانة للمعدات الصناعية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية لمشاريع الهندسة الميكانيكية، بما في ذلك المولدات، التوربينات، وحدات التكييف، المراجل، وشبكات توزيع أنظمة التدفئة والتكييف والتبريد. تطوير خطط وبرامج تجميع وتركيب التجهيزات الميكانيكية للمشاريع الصناعية، وتحديد أنظمة الضبط والتحكم اللازمة. إعداد برامج تشغيل المعدات الصناعية وبرامج الصيانة الوقائية، بالالتزام بتعليمات الشركات المصنعة ومتابعة تنفيذها. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل بشكل مستمر ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب التقدم، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية بدقة. معرفة قوية ببرامج تجميع وتركيب وتشغيل التجهيزات الميكانيكية. فهم عميق لبرامج الصيانة الوقائية للمعدات الصناعية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مصنع أقوات للصناعات الغذائية، وتقع في مدينة مكة المكرمة. سيعمل المهندس الميكانيكي ضمن فريق متخصص يساهم في تطوير وتشغيل العمليات الصناعية للمصنع. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

7b526e5c9e6af49f.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة رباعيات كود للاستشارات الهندسية مهنية عن مهندس ميكانيكي حديث التخرج للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات للمشاريع الهندسية الميكانيكية، بالإضافة إلى تطوير برامج التشغيل والصيانة الوقائية للمعدات والتجهيزات الصناعية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات التفصيلية لمشاريع الهندسة الميكانيكية، بما في ذلك المولدات، التوربينات، وحدات التكييف، المراجل، وشبكات توزيع أنظمة التدفئة والتكييف والتبريد. تطوير خطط وبرامج تجميع وتركيب التجهيزات الميكانيكية للمشاريع الصناعية، وتحديد أنظمة الضبط والتحكم اللازمة. إعداد برامج تشغيل المعدات الصناعية وبرامج الصيانة الوقائية، مع الالتزام بتعليمات الشركات المصنعة ومتابعة تنفيذها. المساهمة في تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات. المؤهلات والخبرة حديث التخرج في تخصص الهندسة الميكانيكية. خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. إتقان مهارات إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية الميكانيكية. المهارات المطلوبة القدرة على إعداد برامج تجميع وتركيب وتشغيل التجهيزات الميكانيكية. مهارة في إعداد برامج تشغيل المعدات الصناعية وبرامج الصيانة الوقائية. القدرة على إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الفنية المتخصصة. مهارات تحليلية وحل المشكلات. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. ستعمل ضمن فريق متخصص في مجال الاستشارات الهندسية، مما يوفر فرصة لتطبيق المعرفة الهندسية في مشاريع متنوعة. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

7b9d24d13c36a62e.description: About the Role JIGPC- Jazan Integrated Gasification and Power Company is seeking an Inspection Engineer to join their team in Jazan, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on supporting the safe, reliable, and compliant operation of the company's gasification and power generation facilities. The successful candidate will be responsible for conducting inspections, monitoring equipment integrity, and ensuring adherence to engineering standards. Role Overview The Integrity & Inspection Engineer will contribute to operational excellence through quality assurance and risk management activities within a complex industrial environment. This position involves collaborating with various teams to resolve integrity and reliability concerns and promoting a strong safety culture. Monitor asset condition and operational performance to identify integrity risks and potential failures. Application Information Salary for this position will be disclosed during the recruitment process.

7bc3db08114fc1e7.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث شركة مجموعة المجال العربي عن سائق شاحنة صغيرة للانضمام إلى فريقها في بريدة، القصيم. تتطلب هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل خبرة تتراوح بين 2 و 5 سنوات في قيادة الشاحنات، وتهدف إلى ضمان نقل فعال وآمن للمعدات الثقيلة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تشغيل وقيادة معدات النقل الثقيل، وتحديداً شاحنات رفع القمامة، مع الالتزام بالمسارات المحددة وخطط العمل المتبعة. الالتزام التام بجميع قواعد المرور، وإجراءات الأمن والسلامة، والتنبه لتجنب ارتكاب أي مخالفات نظامية. إجراء فحوصات دورية ومنتظمة على الشاحنة للتحقق من سلامتها وكفاءتها. معالجة المشكلات والأعطال البسيطة التي قد تطرأ على الشاحنة بشكل فوري. رفع طلبات الصيانة اللازمة للخبراء المختصين عند ملاحظة أي خلل يتطلب فحصاً متخصصاً. الالتزام الكامل بالأدلة الإجرائية، أدلة المواصفات والمعايير، وسياسات وقواعد السلامة العامة المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في قيادة الشاحنات أو معدات النقل الثقيل. رخصة قيادة سارية المفعول تتناسب مع نوع الشاحنة المطلوبة. القدرة على إجراء الفحوصات الأساسية للشاحنة وتحديد الأعطال البسيطة. المهارات والكفاءات معرفة قوية بقواعد المرور وأنظمة السلامة على الطرق. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل والالتزام بالمسارات والجداول الزمنية. مهارات جيدة في التواصل والإبلاغ عن أي مشكلات أو أعطال. الالتزام بالتعليمات والإجراءات التشغيلية. بيئة العمل تتطلب الوظيفة العمل بدوام كامل في مدينة بريدة بمنطقة القصيم. يلتزم شاغل الوظيفة بالعمل ضمن فريق شركة مجموعة المجال العربي، مع التركيز على السلامة والكفاءة في جميع المهام الموكلة إليه. التقديم للوظيفة ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في شركة مجموعة المجال العربي.

7bc518a5948f87d7.description: About the Role Jotun Saudia Co. Ltd. is seeking a Project HSE Manager to oversee the health, safety, and environmental responsibilities for a new solvent-based factory project in Yanbu. This full-time position involves ensuring project work adheres to relevant legal and Jotun HSE requirements, reporting directly to the Project Manager. Key Responsibilities Develop, implement, monitor, and continuously improve the project's Health, Safety, and Environmental management system. Ensure compliance with applicable legal, corporate, and project-specific HSE requirements by all contractors, consultants, and project personnel. Lead the project's HSE function and establish the Project HSE Management Plan. Promote a strong safety culture and a "Zero Harm" philosophy. Provide strategic HSE advice to Project Management and the Steering Committee. Participate in project planning to ensure proper management of HSE risks. Conduct routine site inspections and safety observations, and monitor critical activities. Ensure prompt correction of unsafe acts and conditions. Lead or participate in incident investigations, identify root causes, and determine corrective actions. Monitor the implementation and effectiveness of lessons learned, and prepare incident reports and management summaries. Ensure timely reporting of incidents and near misses. Ensure compliance with local laws, regulations, and permitting requirements, and interface with regulatory authorities as needed. Track regulatory changes affecting the project and support permit inspections and compliance audits. Participate in pre-commissioning and commissioning safety reviews, and support process safety management activities. Verify closure of HSE punch-list items prior to handover and ensure operational readiness from an HSE perspective. Prepare weekly and monthly HSE performance reports for project management and the Steering Committee. Required Experience and Expertise Candidates should possess 5-10 years of experience in HSE within project areas, demonstrating expertise in contributing to and advising on safety matters. The role requires a strong understanding of relevant legal and corporate HSE requirements. Work Environment and Location This position is based in Yanbu, Saudi Arabia, and operates within a full-time capacity. The Project HSE Manager will be an integral part of the project team, ensuring safety standards are met throughout the project lifecycle. The supervisor will ensure compliance with regulatory and safety standards, maintain stock accuracy, and drive continuous improvement in warehouse processes to support operational objectives. Key Responsibilities Oversee daily warehouse operations, including receiving, storing, dispatching, and transferring materials, ensuring accuracy and efficiency. Monitor stock levels and ensure timely replenishment to prevent shortages, overstock, or expired materials. Maintain compliance with GDP, GSP, Civil Defence, and regional FDA regulations, as well as RSD, ensuring proper documentation and reporting. Supervise and train warehouse staff to ensure adherence to procedures, productivity standards, and safety requirements. Maintain organized storage areas with proper classification, labeling, temperature control, and FIFO (First-In-First-Out) practices. Coordinate with procurement and planning teams to ensure accurate material flow and order fulfillment. Ensure warehouse records are properly maintained and transactions are accurately reflected in the ERP system, with all transactions carried out via barcoding. Implement and monitor safety, security, and hygiene standards, ensuring full compliance with Fakeeh Care’s policies. Optimize warehouse space utilization and ensure proper operation of material handling equipment. Prepare periodic reports on stock accuracy, order fulfillment, near-expiry items, and warehouse performance indicators. Support process improvements, digitalization initiatives, and the application of automation tools to enhance efficiency. Maintain fleet coordination for inter-entity deliveries when applicable, ensuring cost-effectiveness and timely service. Perform other duties as assigned within the scope of the job. Experience and Qualifications Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in warehouse operations or a similar supervisory role. A strong understanding of warehouse management principles, regulatory compliance, and inventory control is essential for this position. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in the Makkah region, covering operations in Jeddah and Makkah. The role involves working within a dynamic healthcare environment, requiring adherence to strict safety and regulatory standards.

7b4de7f0dd622cef.description: About the Role: Sous Chef (3D Cake Artist) Hire Fellows is seeking an experienced and hands-on Sous Chef to join the production team of a fast-growing company. This full-time role involves overseeing the day-to-day operations of the kitchen, ensuring all orders are produced on time, to required quality standards, and in line with food safety and operational requirements. The Sous Chef will have end-to-end responsibility for the kitchen floor, managing multiple production sections including cake artistry, decorating, baking, chocolate, and stewarding. Key Responsibilities Oversee daily operations across all kitchen and production sections, including cake artistry, decorating, baking, chocolate, and stewarding. Manage daily production plans to ensure accurate and timely order completion. Monitor recipe adherence and finished-product quality against established standards. Identify and resolve quality issues before products are dispatched. Manage kitchen inventory levels in coordination with Procurement and Inventory teams, aiming to minimize stockouts and waste. Build and adjust staff schedules based on daily order volumes and production needs. Allocate workloads across sections to ensure efficient use of the kitchen team. Lead, coach, and hold section heads and their teams accountable for performance, quality, and productivity. Conduct daily production briefings to communicate order volumes, priorities, special requests, and operational requirements. Identify training and development needs within the kitchen team and collaborate with HR on onboarding and employee development. Enforce food safety, hygiene, sanitation, and HACCP standards throughout the facility. Work closely with the QC team to maintain consistent food safety and quality standards. Manage escalations related to design, product quality, rework, and delivery timelines. Make decisions regarding product rework, holding, or release. Monitor and report kitchen performance, including production output, quality, and on-time completion. Manage key kitchen cost drivers such as labor, ingredients, and wastage against the facility budget. Develop capacity plans for peak periods and ensure all sections are prepared for increased production volumes. Identify opportunities to improve kitchen workflows, layouts, processes, and overall productivity. Act as the senior decision-maker on kitchen equipment, workflow, and operational changes affecting production. Work cross-functionally with Operations, Supply Chain, Marketing, and other teams on new launches, seasonal collections, and production planning. Maintain a clean, organized, safe, and efficient kitchen environment. Qualifications and Experience 7-10 years of professional kitchen, bakery, or food production experience. Proven experience managing a multi-section kitchen, bakery, or high-volume production facility. Strong knowledge of cake production and decoration, including expert-level fondant and cake-craft skills. Excellent attention to detail with a strong understanding of product quality and presentation. Demonstrated experience managing and developing a multi-person kitchen team. Strong experience with staff scheduling, coaching, performance management, and team development. Working knowledge of inventory management, food cost, wastage, and production planning. Strong understanding of food safety, hygiene, sanitation, and HACCP principles. Ability to manage production efficiently against changing order volumes and tight deadlines. Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to remain calm under pressure. Strong leadership and communication skills. Commercially aware with an understanding of kitchen budgets and cost control. Highly organized with strong attention to detail and operational follow-through. Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-volume production environment. Hands-on leadership style with a willingness to be involved in day-to-day kitchen operations. Work Type This is a full-time position. Application Process Candidates meeting the above qualifications are encouraged to apply.

The Clinical Liaison is responsible for building confidence in the hospital’s clinical services and increasing awareness of available rehabilitation and long-term care programs. The position requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Conduct professional visits, presentations, and educational meetings with referral partners. Plan visits to referring hospitals and manage the schedule of clinical assessments. Increase awareness of the hospital’s services, admission criteria, and referral procedures. Maintain accurate records of awareness activities, clinical assessments, decisions, and response times. Identify and develop potential referral sources. Prepare weekly and monthly reports on referral volume, suitability rate, response time, and reasons for non-acceptance. Participate in weekly referral funnel reviews and follow up on agreed actions. Build and maintain professional relationships with physicians, healthcare practitioners, hospitals, and other referral sources. Communicate the hospital’s clinical capabilities, rehabilitation programs, and long-term care services. 7b513da174cdea51.description: We are looking for a Solution Architect to own the technical shape of complex, multi-service platform solutions from vision through to delivery. This role sits between business intent and engineering execution. You will translate requirements into a coherent architecture, make and defend the decisions that constrain how the system is built, and stay engaged through implementation to ensure what ships matches what was designed. The ideal candidate is a hands-on architect — comfortable in a client workshop in the morning and in a design review with engineers in the afternoon — who thinks in trade-offs rather than absolutes. Own the end-to-end solution architecture for assigned platforms and workstreams, across application, data, integration, security and deployment concerns. Translate business and regulatory requirements into architectural decisions, and make the trade-offs explicit. Produce and maintain formal architecture deliverables: architecture vision, high-level design, integration designs, and decision records. Define service boundaries, API contracts, data ownership and event models across a distributed system. Design integration with external and third-party systems, and define the adapter and anti-corruption patterns that keep the core insulated from them. Define the non-functional posture — scalability, availability, performance, resilience, observability — and ensure the design actually meets it. Embed security and compliance requirements into the architecture rather than bolting them on, working closely with security and risk stakeholders. Lead design reviews, guide engineering leads, and govern that implementation stays true to the agreed architecture. Evaluate technologies and vendors, and produce clear, evidence-based recommendations. Identify and articulate architectural risks, assumptions, dependencies and open decisions, and drive them to closure. Support estimation, technical scoping and delivery planning alongside product and delivery leadership. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field 8+ years in software engineering, with at least 3 years in an architecture role on large, multi-service systems A background of building software yourself, with enough current depth to review code and design credibly. Strong command of distributed system design: microservices, service boundaries, API design and versioning, and event-driven architecture. Deep experience with a major backend ecosystem — Java and Spring Boot, or an equivalent enterprise platform. Strong data architecture skills: relational modelling, persistence strategy, transactional integrity and consistency trade-offs across services. Solid grasp of security architecture — identity and access management, OAuth2 / OpenID Connect, authorization models, encryption and secrets management. Experience designing for cloud-native or containerized deployment (Kubernetes or OpenShift) and CI/CD delivery. Proven ability to produce clear architecture documentation and diagrams that engineers can actually build from. Excellent stakeholder communication — able to hold a technical position under challenge and explain it in plain language to a non-technical audience. Excellent verbal and written English communication skills..
